item.title: 【UPSCALED】50 Cent feat. Akon - I'll Still Kill (ALAC - Upscale 4K) (updated 2026)
item.description:
The A.I. spit out a completely clean video, so I had to add the grain back from the original look of the master (yes, I used the master as a comparison all the time). It varies almost on each and every shot, and I done it by hand, shot by shot (because the grain level would vary too much between each one). And there are also scenes that have almost no grain. I believe I managed to make the highest fidelity upscale of this video so far, because that's how it's meant to look: gritty. The file size is a little larger than usual, yes it's the best I could do, this video is too grainy, and I want to keep everything.
